facts.fact: The National Assembly's text of Law L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and the protection of personal data carries the promulgation formula, with the law number and date left blank, and Part Two is a full personal data protection regime; it states no commencement date, and the record is dated only to July 2016 (document published date, month precision).
facts.system: Loi L/2016/037/AN relative à la cybersécurité et la protection des données à caractère personnel

facts.fact: The law defines an Autorité de Protection and gives it functions (declarations and authorisations, transfer approval, investigation, guidelines) but has processing declarations go to the competent authority 'designated by regulation' (Art. 5); it names no constituted body or appointed members (document published 2016-07).
